column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE (SECTION 627)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
1.  This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code

2.
Section 627 of the Civil Procedure Code is amended
to  remove  the  words  “between  persons  professing  Islam”
and replace such words with the words “contracted in terms
of the Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act”.

3.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
